description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit: a light-blue knee-length nightdress with one large yellow star on the chest, short puff sleeves, a white collar below the chin, and closed white slippers. Seen from behind: a plain light-blue nightdress and white slippers. Simple bold shapes, no fine pattern. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
